historical_record.description: An addition of 1951 by Angus McSweeney to the Commodore Stockton School annex.
The Art Commission approved the final preliminary drawings for the Commodore Stockton Elementary School, Project No. 25, designed by Angus McSweeney, Architect.
The Art Commission approved the working drawings for an addition to the Commodore Stockton School, designed by Angus McSweeney, Architect.
The Board of Public Works let the $87,285 general contract for a new Oriental School to Elmer Carlson, to designs by Albert Pissis; the first payment had been made by June 30, 1914.
